purpose: Track the individual review of every active GCP, Azure, and Kubernetes privilege-escalation technique.
completion_rule: Mark completed only after reviewing source semantics, the YAML contract, collector inputs, evaluator joins, and positive and negative cases. Record the supporting evidence.

The existing evaluator only creates an ACR-to-service-principal edge when one verified, usable credential fact names the exact source, registry, and inventoried principal, and the source holds pull/read on that registry.
